items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 November 2026 11:40am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the southern British Isles, bringing complex frontal zones across the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 to 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Friday, then 3 or 4 Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northeast 3 or 4, becoming variable 3 or less by Friday evening. Then becoming east or southeast 3 or 4 Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
